subject: dataframes with factors seem to mess up layer_bars()

messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: dataframes with factors seem to mess up layer_bars()
parts:
Hi again,

Getting some weirdness using data-frames with factors. 

I poked around this group and the ggvis issues, but could not see anything. Is this a known issue?

Code below.

Thanks,

Ian

Using 0.3.0.99:

GithubSHA1: 5a0de1a497544f44fd8ca21a8a81dad528c1fa70
Packaged: 2014-06-24 14:27:07 UTC; ijlyttle


library(dplyr)
library(ggvis)

# this works, month is character
cocaine %>% 
  mutate(month = format(sprintf("%02i", month))) %>%
  ggvis(x = ~month, fill = ~month) %>%
  layer_bars()

# this doesn't, month is factor (only January appears)
cocaine %>% 
  mutate(month = factor(month)) %>%
  ggvis(x = ~month, fill = ~month) %>%
  layer_bars()

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: dataframes with factors seem to mess up layer_bars()
parts:
Both plots look fine to me. Try installing the latest version from Github. Since the commit that you're using, there were some changes to how layer_bars handles factors.

If you still have issues, please post the output of sessionInfo().

-Winston
